title: DeployActivated
description:
Contract `sites/deploy-activated.v1`: the answer of
`POST /v1/sites/{site}/deploys/{commit}/activate`.

The deploy of `current_commit` is now the deploy that the gateway serves for the site. Every
other member is refused.

current_commit.description: The commit whose deploy is now current.

previous_commit.description:
The commit whose deploy was current before, kept so that activating it again needs no
download. Absent when the site had no current deploy before.

site_id.description: The site whose current deploy changed.

SiteId.description:
The id of one site: 3 to 40 lower-case ASCII letters, digits and `-`.

The grammar is the `site:<site id>` form of `WriteOrigin` in `ratatoskr-notes-contracts`.
The owner chooses the id, and it appears in every route under `/v1/sites/{site}/`.
